item.title: github: License data quality improvements
item.description:
GitHub now sources license information for dependency graph software components from package registries such as npmjs.org and PyPI. This is intended to improve the accuracy and completeness of displayed license data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Hard budget limits now available for GitHub Advanced Security
item.description:
GitHub Advanced Security now supports hard budget limits for GHAS SKUs, allowing enterprise admins and billing managers to prevent teams from exceeding allocated license budgets. This applies to license-based GHAS products.

  • Source: GitHub
